metadata.author: Carl Laferton
metadata.description:
Explore the big story of the Bible with this engaging audio collection, based on the popular God’s Big Promises Bible Storybook. Features 92 faithfully told stories that take young listeners on a journey through the Bible, from the very beginning to the very end.  

Each story is beautifully narrated by Andrew Wilson, easy to follow and full of meaning, helping children understand how the events in the Bible connect together as one big story full of hope and purpose.  

What’s Inside:  

- 92 Bible stories brought to life through clear and engaging narration  
- A focus on the big themes of promise, hope, and rescue  
- A journey from creation through to the life, death, and resurrection of Jesus  
- Perfect for bedtime, quiet time, or listening on the go  

Written by Carl Laferton and illustrated by Jennifer Davison, this storybook has been praised for its clarity, warmth, and ability to explain deep truths in a way children can understand.  

A wonderful introduction to the Bible’s big message for families looking to share timeless stories and thoughtful values.
